overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs DCT Barrel with 304 Stainless Steel Exterior is a premium wellness solution designed for relaxation and rejuvenation. Perfect for home use, this spacious barrel features a sleek stainless steel interior and a beautiful Pacific Cedar exterior, offering both durability and aesthetic appeal. Ideal for basements or fitness rooms, it provides a comfortable seating area to unwind, promoting muscle relaxation and stress relief. With safety features like a custom cover with child safety latches and an optional chiller, this product ensures a secure and customizable experience for every user.

_raw.Product Ad-Copy: Immerse yourself in the next level of recovery with our state-of-the-art cold plunge pools. Designed for peak performance and ultimate rejuvenation, Dynamic Cold Therapy brings you the power of icy immersion in the comfort of your own space.
_raw.Feature 1\nDelivery: This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier.
Features: Premium Pacific Cedar Exterior: The tub's exterior is crafted from the finest Pacific Cedar, renowned for its natural beauty and resilience against the elements. This premium wood finish not only adds a touch of elegance to your outdoor or indoor spaces but also promises lasting durability.
304 Stainless Steel Interior: Tailor your cold plunge experience with our elegant 304 Stainless Steel, which offers a sleek and premium feel.

Spacious and Ergonomic Design: With its generous dimensions (42” Wide x 39.5” Tall) and an ergonomically designed built-in seat, the tub provides ample space for a comfortable and relaxing cold therapy session.

Convenient Access with Safety in Mind: The inclusion of a high-quality Pacific Cedar step ensures safe and easy entry and exit, while the custom cover with child safety latches guarantees peace of mind when the tub is not in use.
Uncompromised Quality and Assurance: The Dynamic Cold Tub Barrel comes with a 1-year warranty, underscoring our commitment to quality and your long-term satisfaction.
